PET Cup Size Comparison: 78mm vs 93mm Models for Beverage Menus

Article Quick Facts

78mm Models
5.5 oz and 8 oz
93mm Models
9 oz and 12 oz
Listed Weight Range
6 g to 11 g
Listed Carton Quantity
1,000 pcs for all four models

Why Compare Caliber, Capacity and Profile Together

A PET cup comparison is more useful when it includes the rim caliber, capacity, height, base diameter and weight. The 78mm and 93mm rows in the Claropack catalog show that a larger listed capacity is accompanied by changes in the vertical profile, base and grammage. Use the full row when checking a menu, carrier or filling setup.

78mm vs 93mm PET Catalog Reference

All values below are copied from the PET cold cup category specification table. The table is a sourcing reference, not a final quotation or production drawing.

ModelCaliberCapacityHeightBaseWeightCarton Quantity
5.5-780178 mm5.5 oz54 mm52 mm6 g1,000 pcs
8oz-780278 mm8 oz80 mm48 mm6 g1,000 pcs
93-9oz93 mm9 oz71 mm55 mm8 g1,000 pcs
930193 mm12 oz108 mm58 mm11 g1,000 pcs

How the 78mm Pair Fits a Smaller Menu Tier

The 78mm rows cover 5.5oz and 8oz. The 5.5oz model is listed at 54mm high with a 52mm base, while the 8oz model is 80mm high with a 48mm base. Because the base and height are not identical, confirm the selected model against the carrier, holder and filling equipment rather than assuming one footprint.

How the 93mm Pair Extends the Menu

The 93mm rows cover 9oz and 12oz. The 9oz model is listed at 71mm high, 55mm base and 8g; the 12oz model is 108mm high, 58mm base and 11g. This gives buyers a larger-volume comparison set, but the exact lid model and sealing arrangement still need to be checked against the selected cup.

What to Put in the Supplier Request

State the model code first, then caliber, capacity, height, base, weight and carton quantity. Printing details, final drawings, exact lid fit, production tolerance and destination documentation are not contained in this catalog table and remain待工厂确认.

Article FAQs

Are all four models packed at the same carton quantity?

The listed PET catalog rows show 1,000 pcs for all four models. Confirm the final carton configuration for any customized order.

Does a 93mm cup always have a larger base than a 78mm cup?

Not necessarily. The listed 8oz 78mm model has a 48mm base, while the listed 9oz and 12oz 93mm models have 55mm and 58mm bases. Compare the exact model row.

Can I choose a lid from the caliber alone?

Use caliber as the starting point, but confirm exact lid fit with the selected model and supplier drawing before bulk production.
